categories.application-owner: server.py, application, HTTP middleware, launch scripts or shared libraries; not Phase 2.
categories.parity-harness: Specifies the parity harness itself (fake project, child environment and launch routes); it exercises neither manager and is not a parity case.
categories.client-unchanged: serverctl/lifecycle_approval/deployment client side; the manager protocol is unchanged so the tests still apply.
categories.parity-and-rust-unit: Covered by both the parity harness and named Rust unit tests.
categories.parity-black-box: Manager behaviour covered by the black-box parity harness running against the Rust manager.
categories.python-owner-retained: Tests a Python owner Phase 2 deliberately keeps (reached through a preparation/host child or manager_bridge, or deliberately unused by the Rust manager); the test runs unchanged against that owner.
categories.rust-unit: Manager behaviour re-specified by named Rust unit tests in packages/tofu-manager.
